title: Ireland – Telecommunications services – 25/046 - Qualification System for provision of Telecommunications Services
description: Gas Networks Ireland (GNI) is seeking to establish a comprehensive Qualification System for Telecommunication Services. This system aims to ensure that all telecommunications providers and solutions engaged by GNI meet consistent standards of quality, reliability, security, and compliance. The Qualification System will underpin the procurement and management of telecommunications services required for the effective operation, maintenance, and development of GNI’s gas transmission and distribution network. Scope of Services The Qualification System will cover a wide range of telecommunications services, including but not limited to: • WAN technologies • ISP services • Innovation in the utility sector • Enterprise telephony (on-premise and cloud) • Mobile SIMS and network connectivity data SIMs • Video Conferencing services • Cloud hosting services • Managed connectivity and carrier diversity The service coverage will include the Republic of Ireland, the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, as well as the Isle of Man.

title: Cont SyscadRTK- 1 an/doua conexiuni simultan
description:
SysCAD Solutions SRL, companie aflata din 2002 pe piata de distributie de echipamente topografice, a lansat in luna Octombrie 2019 reteaua privata de statii GPS permanente pentru corectii GNSS in timp real. Reteaua are in componenta sa un numar de 50 de statii de referinta ce receptioneaza si utilizeaza semnalul satelitar de la principalele constelatii satelitare (GPS + GLONASS + BEIDOU + GALILEO) si se adreseaza atat utilizatorilor de echipamente GNSS destinate masuratorilor topografice cat si agricultorilor si producatorilor de masini si utilaje agricole ce necesita corectii GPS pentru o pozitionare precisa. Corectiile sunt disponibile in format standard RTCM si ofera precizie centimetrica cu acoperire nationala. Suplimentar SysCAD Solutions ofera si fisiere pentru masuratori GNSS statice in format RINEX 2.1 la interval de 5 secunde. Reteaua poate fi testata gratuit timp de doua zile, atat prin generarea automata pe siteul syscadrtk.ro a unui cont DEMO, precum si prin contactarea inginerilor de retea prin email la adresa office@cadsolutions.ro.

title: PERFORMANCE ANALYSIS EGS-CC BASED APPLICATIONS- EXPRO PLUS
description: The EGS-CC (European Ground System Common Core) project aims at developing the common core functions of the next generation European Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE) and Mission Control Systems (MCS). The facilities build from the EGS-CC will support the functional verification (FV) of satellites at early development stages, the satellite level assembly integration and verification (AIV) process and the Mission Control pre- and post-launch. The EGS-CC project is currently in phase C/D.Performance of a system isits responsiveness/scalability and stability/reliability under particular workload. Ensuring optimal performance from a complex system like the EGS-CC is a difficult task as critical functions like telemetry archiving, telecommanding and telemetry processing are carried out in parallel through collaboration of multiple components and it is difficult to apportion performance to individual components. For EGS-CC to be a successful product, its performance must meet existing requirements and allow improvement of that performance in future evolution.This activity aims at ensuring that the expected performance of the integrated EGSCC product, e.g. the EGS-CC components themselves or applications built on top of it, is achieved in an optimal manner and even exceeded.In the frame of this activity the following tasks are foreseen: - Implement the necessary tools and facilties to measure performance and the system and component levels - Measure performance and associated quality attributes of the EGS-CC based on existing Reference Test Facility and defined test scenarios - Analyse and evaluate EGS-CC performance requirements based on measurements - Write evaluation report with possible recommendations
